entries.name: resources
entries.hint: Create a group of routes that exposes actions for manipulating a collection of resources.

entries.heading: Routing
entries.text: Routes map URLs to controller actions. Declare them in config/routes.cfm.

entries.heading: Nested resources
entries.text:
Nest one resource inside another with the callback form:

```cfm
.resources(name="posts", callback=function(map) { map.resources("comments"); })
```

The nested routes get the parent key as postKey.

entries.heading: Soft Delete
entries.text: A deletedAt column turns delete() into a soft delete: the row stays and finders skip it.

entries.heading: Finding many records
entries.text: findAll() returns a query. Pass where and order to narrow and sort the records.
